subject.title: fix: prevent exec output capture test timeout flake

question: Should the bounded output-capture test permanently rely on Vitest's test deadline rather than its own two-second command watchdog, after the current head is refreshed and its process-exec check completes?
rationale: The patch changes a test-contract boundary rather than runtime behavior, and the protected `maintainer` label requires a human to accept that boundary despite positive targeted proof.

options.title: Accept the focused test boundary
options.body: Merge after the current head is refreshed and the process-exec check passes, keeping timeout behavior covered only by the dedicated timer tests.

options.title: Retain an explicit watchdog
options.body: Request a different deterministic test design if maintainers require every child-process test to enforce its own command lifetime independently of Vitest.

recommendation.title: Accept the focused test boundary
recommendation.body: Merge after the current head is refreshed and the process-exec check passes, keeping timeout behavior covered only by the dedicated timer tests.
